Chief ACK + LANDED: the open-world metrics fix 8b36e32 is on main, embed-bench tree byte-identical, embed-bench 49 (was 44), fixtures 108, scalafmt and compileAll green. bd-01M165MNSJ7SXHA8VQ0KSB6NEE CLOSED.

WHAT IS FIXED, all three sites through one carrier: MetricObservation is now Ineligible | Observed | Missing, and an exclusively-Unranked row no longer becomes a substantive observation on ANY of them. external-over-source no longer scores 1.0 for a unit we could not rank; externalSubtype no longer records our inability to rank as the participant having the wrong subtype; inferenceMass no longer publishes provider abstention as evidence of no inferential content. Aggregation returns Estimate.Missing with coverage rather than conditioning on survivors, so selective abstention cannot move the number in either direction.

THAT LAST CLAUSE IS WHY THIS TOOK THREE ATTEMPTS. My own first prescription - 'Unranked rows yield None' - WAS the renormalization trap, because the aggregate drops None: [1,0] scoring 0.5 would have become [1,None] scoring 1.0, and a channel could have raised its published accuracy by becoming less able to rank. The scout caught that before writing a line of it. What landed is the version that survives the adversarial test in BOTH directions.

REVIEW PATH, and it is the shape I want for anything touching a published number: authored by codex-storymodel4s-scout after a pre-candidate sweep that itself found two of the three sites; BLOCKED by codex-storymodel-new-engineer on a public-API defect; amended; independently re-reviewed and ACCEPTED by the same reviewer; merged-tree gated by me; landed. Nobody in that chain acked their own work, and the two blocks that caught the most tonight - this one and the scout's on m1's Resolution type - both came from a reader with no stake in the outcome.

THE SIGN-AGNOSTIC POINT IS THE NIGHT'S FINDING: the same conflation flattered us on one metric and penalised the participant on two others. We were not systematically flattering ourselves - we were treating absence as a substantive value in whichever direction the surrounding arithmetic happened to point. A category error whose sign is incidental is harder to catch by inspecting results than any directional bias would be.
